cd /workspace; for f in next.config.ts lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd /workspace/node_modules/next; ls; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "unstable_prefetch\|forceStale\|unstable_instant" dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30
